title: 第二十七章     似曾相识
content_zh:
“哎！我说你小子先前这么磨蹭，怎么现在走这么快了！”李朗追在琼霄身后喊道。

    “我哪里走快了，那是你走的太慢！”琼霄头也不回的笑道。

    “切！快到女生区域了，何必如此着急！”李朗咧咧嘴，道。

    “我时间宝贵着呢，事情办完，我还要找个星辰之力充沛的地方，进行突破，看看能不能一举进入玄星境，这新生中，我的修炼速度已经够慢了，想要保护湘儿，那么我就必须要努力！”

    “额，好吧，你时间宝贵！”李朗无奈道。

    “你在学院里晃了几天了，知道学院里的学生在哪里修炼没有！？”琼霄边走着便询问道。

    “学院里的确有着修炼之所，不过想要进入修炼，是要有一定代价的！”李朗微微一笑，道。

    “哦？既然有这回事？需要什么代价？”琼霄顿时来了劲头。

    “呵呵，在这里不管你多么富有，但是在学院之中，金币不能流通，在这里有着一种特殊的货币，那就是星币，那就是功勋值，在这里的一切消费，都需要功勋值，不过我现在也只是个穷人……”

    “哦？那什么是功勋值？”琼霄来了兴致。

    “所谓功勋值，就是完成学院的任物，又或者到学院拍卖地点以物品拍卖，或者从他人手中夺取，都可获得功勋值，就我俩来说，卖东西是不可能了，在这里咱俩都是穷人，只能靠接任务来过得功勋值了！”李朗耸了耸肩，无奈道。

    “看来这个功勋值很有用，我们必须去弄些功勋值，以保证正常消费。”琼霄轻轻一笑。

    “好了，先不说了，我们还是先去女生区域看看，碰碰运气，兴许还真能碰到八大女神之一也不一定啊！”李朗**的笑道。

    “看你那点出息，”琼霄转身鄙夷道。

    一直朝前走着的李朗，突然停下脚步，目光呆滞的看着前方。

    看到李朗那奇怪的行为，琼霄不禁问道：“你小子怎么了！”

    可李朗仿佛没有听到琼霄的声音，一直看着前方。

    “额……”李朗没有回话，到底是什么让李朗紧紧盯着前方，他好奇的转回身。

    只见远处走来一位女子，她身穿白色裙子，阳光下那女子有着浓密的长发，清澈明亮的瞳孔，弯弯的柳眉，极度标致的面庞。她那长长的睫毛微微地颤动着，白皙无瑕的皮肤透出淡淡红粉，薄薄的双唇如玫瑰花瓣娇嫩欲滴，周身无时无刻不散发着一种特殊的气质，她一路走来，所有人的目光都聚集在她的身上，随着她走动而移动。

    “好美，此女只应天上有，人间哪有几回闻！跟我的湘儿一样，她们都是如此之美，美得让人陶醉！”琼霄呢喃道。

    随着女子缓缓走近身旁，而此刻的琼霄早已停下脚步，一直盯着朝他走来的绝色女子。

    咕咚！琼霄的心，狠狠的跳动了一下，：“怎么回事，我的心里怎么会有一种难以言表的苦涩之感。”

    那仿佛从天际而来的女子迈着轻盈的步伐，缓缓而来，十丈，八丈，五丈……

    一丈！此刻琼霄的心强烈的跳动着，一种极度熟悉的感觉油然而生，一种愧疚之情如泉涌一般喷出，琼霄想迈出步伐，可怎么也迈不出去！

    “为什么会这样！为什么我会对她产生一种愧疚之感！为什么我总觉得她很熟悉！为什么我想要去抱抱她！”琼霄自问道。

    那女子终于走到他身边，从他身旁缓缓走过，而琼霄笔直的站着，脸上露出迷茫的表情。

    “我们认识吗？”那女子突然停下脚步，缓缓转身，望着还呆呆站立的琼霄。

    一道轻柔的声音突然响起，把琼霄拉回了现实世界。

    “应该不认识，你我不曾见过面！”琼霄摇了摇头，他在说这句话的时候心中仿佛在滴血。
content_en:
"Hey! Why are you walking so fast now when you were so lazy earlier?" Li Lang shouted after Qiong Xiao.

"I'm not walking fast, it's because you're walking too slow!" Qiong Xiao said with a smile without looking back.

"Tch! We're almost at the girls' area, why are you in such a hurry!" Li Lang said with a grin.

"My time is precious. After finishing the matter, I still need to find a place with abundant star power to make a breakthrough and see if I can enter the Xuanxing realm in one fell swoop. In this new life, my cultivation speed is already slow enough. If I want to protect Xiang'er, then I must work hard!"

"Uh, okay, your time is precious!" Li Lang said helplessly.

"You have been hanging around the academy for a few days. Do you know where the students in the academy are practicing!?" Qiong Xiao asked as he walked.

"There is indeed a place for cultivation in the academy, but if you want to enter cultivation, you have to pay a certain price!" Li Lang said with a slight smile.

"Oh? Since this is the case? What is the price?" Qiong Xiao suddenly became more energetic.

"Haha, no matter how rich you are here, gold coins cannot circulate in the academy. There is a special currency here, which is star coins, and that is merit points. All consumption here requires merit points, but I am just a poor person now..."

"Oh? Then what is meritorious service?" Qiong Xiao became interested.

"The so-called merit points mean that you can get merit points by completing tasks assigned by the academy, or by auctioning items at the academy's auction site, or taking them from others. As far as we are concerned, selling things is impossible. We are both poor here, so we can only earn merit points by accepting tasks!" Li Lang shrugged and said helplessly.

"It seems that this merit point is very useful. We must get some merit points to ensure normal consumption." Qiong Xiao smiled softly.

"Okay, let's not talk about it for now. Let's go to the girls' area first and try our luck. Maybe we can actually meet one of the eight goddesses!" Li Lang said with a passionate smile.

"Look at your potential," Qiong Xiao turned around and said contemptuously.

Li Lang, who had been walking forward, suddenly stopped and looked ahead blankly.

Seeing Li Lang's strange behavior, Qiong Xiao couldn't help asking: "What's wrong with you kid!"

But Li Lang didn't seem to hear Qiong Xiao's voice and kept looking ahead.

"Uh..." Li Lang didn't reply. What was it that made Li Lang stare straight ahead? He turned back curiously.

I saw a woman walking from a distance. She was wearing a white dress. Under the sun, the woman had thick long hair, clear and bright pupils, curved eyebrows, and an extremely beautiful face.Her long eyelashes trembled slightly, her fair and flawless skin revealed a faint pink color, her thin lips were as delicate as rose petals, and her whole body exuded a special temperament all the time. As she walked, everyone's eyes were focused on her, moving as she walked.

"So beautiful, this girl should only exist in heaven, and how many times can we hear it in the human world! Just like my Xiang'er, they are all so beautiful, so beautiful that people are intoxicated!" Qiong Xiao murmured.

As the woman slowly approached him, Qiong Xiao had already stopped and stared at the stunning woman walking towards him.

Gudong!Qiong Xiao's heart beat hard, "What's going on? Why do I have an indescribable feeling of bitterness in my heart."

The woman who seemed to come from the sky came slowly with light steps, ten feet, eight feet, five feet...

One foot!At this moment, Qiong Xiao's heart was beating strongly, an extremely familiar feeling suddenly emerged, and a feeling of guilt spurted out like a spring. Qiong Xiao wanted to take a step, but she couldn't!

"Why is this happening! Why do I feel guilty about her! Why do I always feel that she is so familiar! Why do I want to hug her!" Qiong Xiao asked herself.

The woman finally came to him and walked slowly past him, while Qiong Xiao stood upright with a confused expression on her face.

"Do we know each other?" The woman suddenly stopped, turned around slowly, and looked at Qiong Xiao, who was still standing blankly.

A soft voice suddenly sounded, pulling Qiong Xiao back to the real world.

"I don't think we know each other. You and I have never met before!" Qiong Xiao shook his head, and his heart seemed to be bleeding when he said this.
